services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Most people remember their first skydive in pieces - the moment in the door, the second the parachute opens and everything goes quiet, the sight of the coastline sliding past underneath them. This post is a walk-through of that day, so you know what's coming - and so you can show up ready to soak it in. Book your slot online, and you'll get a confirmation email with directions, what to wear, and a link to the waiver. Three things that make the day go better: When you walk in, we'll know your name.
